h1: Get your MCP server into the Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini stores
lead: Each store checks different things: OAuth, tool annotations, descriptions, error handling, policy text. We find what blocks you, fix it, and submit. Fixed prices in US dollars.

services.name: Readiness Audit
services.short: Find out what stops your server from being listed, in order of what blocks you first.
services.price_note: List price $750. Report in 3 business days.
scope: We run McpStamp Check on your endpoint, then read the server by hand.
OAuth flow, tool annotations, tool descriptions and error handling.
Store policies for the Claude Directory, ChatGPT apps, Gemini Connected Apps and the MCP Registry.
you_get: A written fix list, ranked by store blocker
A code snippet for each fix
A 30-minute call to go through it
services.price_tag: Founding price for the first 10 audits
services.credit: 100% of the audit fee is credited if you buy Store Launch or a custom server within 30 days.

services.name: Store Launch
services.short: We fix your server so it passes, then submit it to all four stores.
services.price_note: All 4 stores. About 10 business days. $1,500 deposit now, $3,400 at handover.
scope: We fix your server until it passes McpStamp Check and each store's published review list.
OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration, PKCE and refresh tokens.
Tool annotations, server instructions and clear tool descriptions.
We prepare the listings and submit them from your store accounts: Claude, ChatGPT, the MCP Registry, and Gemini when your account has access.
you_get: Fixes as commits in your repository
Up to 2 review rounds: we fix what reviewers ask and resubmit
services.note: Gemini: Google opened Connected Apps in preview on 28 Oct 2026, for US developers through a waitlist; over 50 apps were listed at launch (TechCrunch, 28 Oct 2026). If your account has no Gemini access when we finish, we deliver a Gemini-ready server and the submission pack, and you choose: we submit later at no charge, or we take $900 off the balance.

faq.q: Does the audit fee count toward a launch?
faq.a: Yes. If you buy Store Launch or a custom server within 30 days of the audit, we credit 100% of the audit fee.
We email you to ask for your server URL and repo access. The audit's 3 business days start when we have access.

faq.q: Does the deposit count toward the price?
faq.a: Yes. For Store Launch, you pay $1,500 first and $3,400 at handover. For a custom server, the $1,500 deposit comes off the fixed quote.

faq.q: Can you promise the stores will accept my server?
faq.a: No. Anthropic, OpenAI and Google review each listing themselves. Store Launch includes up to 2 review rounds: we fix what reviewers ask and resubmit. Gemini submission also needs your account to have Connected Apps access (a US waitlist preview since 28 Oct 2026).

faq.q: Is there a minimum term for the Care plan?
faq.a: Yes, 3 months. It is invoiced each month and includes 2 fix hours a month.
Not on this page. We'd rather show work you can check. The merged pull requests and the MCP Registry listings above are public.

faq.q: Can you work with our private data?
faq.a: We can build against a sample or a test account, so your real data never has to leave your side.
